title: 软质高品质毛绒玩具
prompt: A soft, high-quality plush toy of [CHARACTER], with an oversized head, small body, and stubby limbs. Made of fuzzy fabric with visible stitching and embroidered facial features. The plush is shown sitting or standing against a neutral background. The expression is cute or expressive, and it wears simple clothes or iconic accessories if relevant. Lighting is soft and even, with a realistic, collectible plush look. Centered, full-body view. 1080x1080.
description: 借助 Nano Banana Pro 模型，打造栩栩如生的高品质毛绒玩具，细腻的软绒材质与生动表情细节，完美适用于品牌玩具、促销周边或收藏品摄影，展现精致缝线与可爱设计，搭配中性背景与均匀光线，呈现专业电商视觉效果。
